playstyle.identity: Wukong is a trickster diver who can clone himself and knock up entire teams with his spinning ultimate. He excels at teamfight disruption and assassinating carries.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gains armor/MR near enemies. Q extends staff and reduces armor. W creates a clone and stealths briefly (clone attacks). E dashes to target and clones attack. R spins, knocking up and gaining movement speed. W to juke, E in, R for teamfight knockups.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Wukong spikes at level 6 with double knockup (R can be cast twice). Divine Sunderer or bruiser items work. He's strong at teamfighting and diving.

passive.name: Stone Skin
passive.summary: Gain armor and health regen near enemies.
passive.details: Wukong gains bonus armor and health regeneration for each nearby enemy champion.

abilities.name: Crushing Blow
abilities.summary: Next attack extends range and reduces armor.
abilities.details: Wukong's next auto attack gains range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the target's armor.

abilities.name: Warrior Trickster
abilities.summary: Become invisible and leave a clone that attacks.
abilities.details: Wukong becomes invisible briefly and creates a clone that attacks nearby enemies. The clone can trigger on-hit effects.

abilities.name: Nimbus Strike
abilities.summary: Dash to an enemy; clone also dashes to nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Wukong dashes to a target enemy, dealing damage and gaining attack speed. His clone also dashes to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Cyclone
abilities.summary: Spin to knock up enemies; can cast twice.
abilities.details: Wukong spins his staff, knocking up and damaging nearby enemies while gaining movement speed. He can cast this ability a second time within a short window.
